## Fatal finding

- [`thm-finite-second-moment-lower-bound`](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-finite-second-moment-lower-bound.md:4) — **Title**.

  The title asserts the unqualified formula
  \[
  \mathbb P(X\ne0)\ge\frac{\mathbb E[X]^2}{\mathbb E[X^2]},
  \]
  but the denominator may vanish. For the constant-zero variable on a one-point probability space, both moments are zero, so the title’s right-hand side is \(0/0\), which is undefined.

  The Statement correctly restricts the quotient to \(\mathbb E[X^2]>0\) and handles the zero case separately; proof step 2.1 likewise says, “Dividing by the positive second moment.” Thus the title asserts more than the proof delivers.

  **Severity: fatal.**
